name: Apps400

sources.title: Homepage — active app-review blog; footer states 'Paid reviews from $49. Network placement across 12 sites, $349. Published within 7–10 working days.'

requirements: Covers iOS, Android, web apps and SaaS tools ('Independent app reviews since 2010')
Site states pricing up front: paid reviews from $49; network placement across 12 sites for $349; publication within 7–10 working days
preparation: App/product name, store or web URL, description and screenshots
Budget: minimum $49 for a single review; $349 for the 12-site network package
workflow: Open https://apps400.com/submit-your-application-for-review and complete the submission form
Pay the review fee (from $49) or the $349 network package
Review publishes within the stated 7–10 working days
watchFor: Explicitly a paid-review site — no free route is offered; do not count coverage as earned media
Same AppMarketingPlus network as appiod.com, webapprater.com, appsmirror.com etc. — network placements across these sites are one package, not independent wins
Homepage mixes reviews with off-topic sponsored posts (mattresses, MLM software) — low editorial signal
Sells sidebar ad slots ($40/mo) — the whole site is monetized placement
countsAsLive: A review post naming the product is published on apps400.com under its category (e.g. /web-apps/, /iphone-apps/, /android-apps/)
unknowns: Exact single-review price within the 'from $49' range and what tiers exist
Which 12 sites comprise the current network package
